items.title: 10.1 Oxidation, reduction and redox reactions (electrons ka khona, lena aur dono saath) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the chapter opening and topic 10.1, printed pages 212-213.

blocks.title: Electrochemistry
blocks.text: Chemistry ki woh branch (shaakh) jo electrical energy aur chemical energy ke aapas mein badalne (inter conversion) ko parhti hai, yani electrical energy ko chemical energy mein aur chemical energy ko electrical energy mein, electrochemistry kehlati hai.

blocks.title: Oxidation
blocks.text: Oxidation woh process (amal) hai jis mein ek ya zyada electrons khoye (lose) jate hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein Zn⁰ → Zn⁺² + e⁻ chhapa hai. Zinc ka atom Zn⁺² banne ke liye do electrons khota hai, is liye sahi half-equation Zn⁰ → Zn⁺² + 2e⁻ hai; isi tarah dono taraf charge barabar hota hai (0 = +2 − 2).
Yahan Fe⁺² aur Zn⁰ ne electrons khoye hain, is liye yeh oxidize hue hain.

blocks.title: Reduction
blocks.text: Reduction woh process hai jis mein ek ya zyada electrons hasil (gain) kiye jate hain.
In misalon mein Cl⁰ aur Cu⁺² ne electrons hasil kiye hain, is liye yeh reduce hue hain.

blocks.title: Redox reactions
blocks.text: Oxidation aur reduction hamesha ek saath hote hain. Jin reactions mein yeh dono saath hon, unhen redox reactions kehte hain.

blocks.title: Interesting Information (dilchasp maloomat)
blocks.text: Photosynthesis ek redox reaction hai jo poori duniya ke liye food banata hai, aur respiration (saans ka amal) bhi redox reaction hai jo aap ko zinda rakhta hai.
Kisi chemical reaction mein koi substance oxidize hua ya reduce, yeh maloom karne ke do tareeqe hain:

items: Electron transfer (electrons ka ek se doosre ko jana)

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Yaad rakhne ka tareeqa: OIL RIG — Oxidation Is Loss, Reduction Is Gain (electrons ka). Fe⁺² ek electron kho kar Fe⁺³ banta hai, is liye us ka charge barhta hai; Cu⁺² do electrons le kar Cu⁰ banta hai, is liye us ka charge ghatta hai.

blocks.prompt: Mg → Mg²⁺ + 2e⁻ aur O₂ + 4e⁻ → 2O²⁻ mein kaun sa oxidation hai aur kaun sa reduction?
blocks.explanation: Mg do electrons khota hai, is liye Mg → Mg²⁺ + 2e⁻ oxidation hai. O₂ electrons leta hai, is liye O₂ + 4e⁻ → 2O²⁻ reduction hai. Dono mil kar ek redox reaction banate hain: 2Mg + O₂ → 2MgO.

items: Electrochemistry: electrical aur chemical energy ka aapas mein badalna.
Oxidation = electrons khona (Fe⁺² → Fe⁺³ + e⁻, Zn⁰ → Zn⁺² + 2e⁻); reduction = electrons lena (Cl⁰ + e⁻ → Cl⁻¹, Cu⁺² + 2e⁻ → Cu⁰).
Dono hamesha saath hote hain: redox reaction. Pehchan ke do tareeqe: electron transfer aur oxidation number ki tabdeeli.
